# Public instance reifiable-input results

Independently authored instance methods keep their own Object result formal
beside a String input, or no inputs, in a closed Carrier<Provider> owner.
A renamed-formal override, generic Exception-catching caller and immutable
harness retain virtual dispatch, receiver/key snapshots, volatile opaque values,
late mutation, caller casts, ignored calls and exact RuntimeException/Error
behavior. The key provides no relation to the actual returned object.

Source and SDK modes compile every emitted unit and audit all original runtime
definitions, roles, Signatures, Exceptions and generated helpers. Both repeat
144 fresh-JVM cases twice. Independent wrong programs precede recovery, and
same-Code metadata controls reject open scope and unsupported exception/bound

The catch observer records and checks the original exception object. This also
retains the explicit move-exception handler entry required by this fixture.
